body:
Universal Engineering Proof System. Combines formal methods, simulation, experimental evidence, and operational testing to establish specific claims.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 88 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Beyond Conventional Technology Categories". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Proof systems are real (Lean, TLA+); universal engineering proof is emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Universal Engineering Proof System - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Combines formal methods, simulation, experimental evidence, and operational testing to establish specific claims.
body:
Known science foundations of Universal Engineering Proof System.

seL4 and CompCert are verified. TLA+ checks distributed systems. But a universal system combining formal methods, simulation, experiments, and operations to prove engineering claims is the frontier.

Key quantity check (Verified systems in production / engineering claims per year in millions): computed ratio 1 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Universal Engineering Proof System - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Combines formal methods, simulation, experimental evidence, and operational testing to establish specific claims.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Universal Engineering Proof System.

Formal methods don't scale to full systems. Evidence integration is manual. Proofs are expensive.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 6 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is verified vs claims at 6 orders of magnitude (claims larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
